validity.recommendation: Replace length 292 km with 366.7 km and start 1981 with 1977 per the operator table, or document the sheet values. 29 bcm/y is a system figure.
validity.researcher_notes: The line is real and not a duplicate of P3484. The Ukrainian operator history table lists string I (1976, 357.7 km) and string II (1977, 366.7 km) as separate pipes. A 2011 Ukrainian engineering paper on the Dniester crossing of string II also treats it as its own pipe. Sheet problems: length 292 km is not supported, start 1981 is not supported, and 29 bcm/y is a system figure copied to both rows. The Urengoy fuel source has no support. The operator cell lacks the Ukrainian operator. A third string exists in the table (17.8 km, 1979) and has no GEM row.

fills.researcher_notes: The iSANS report (2023) gives about 30 bcm a year for the whole twin-thread Ivatsevichi-Dolina line. That is a system figure, not a figure for one string, so it is not used as a ref for this row. At 1220 mm one string would carry about 15 to 20 bcm a year. No per-string capacity found. Searched in Russian and Ukrainian.

verifications.note: двухниточный магистральный газопровод «Ивацевичи — Долина» диаметром 1220 мм

fills.researcher_notes: Three publishers agree on 1220 mm: the iSANS report (2023), the Gazprom Transgaz Belarus activities page (2023 capture), and the Ukrainian operator history table, which gives 1220 mm for string II. The names match the sheet closely.

No source found that names Urengoy gas as the supply for this line. Note the Urengoy field first produced gas in 1978, after the recorded start. The Ukrainian operator history says this line began as a reversal of the older Dashava-Minsk flow. Searched in Russian and Ukrainian.

verifications.note: Івацевичі - Долина (II нитка) довжиною 366,7 км, ∅1220 мм

fills.researcher_notes: The sheet says 292 km. The Ukrainian operator history table gives 366.7 km for string II of Ivatsevichi-Dolina. The sheet value looks wrong. It may be half of a 146 km figure that appears in other sources for each string, but no source found states 292. Caution: it is not clear whether the table figure covers the whole run from Ivatsevichi or only part. The other string is given as 357.7 km, so the two strings differ. Proposed as a change with a spec concern. The geometry on the sheet measures about 480 km.

fills.researcher_notes: The operator's own activities page (2023 capture) lists the line. It covers the Belarus section only. The Ukrainian section is run by the Ukrainian gas transmission operator, so the cell is incomplete.

fills.researcher_notes: The Ukrainian operator history table says string II of Ivatsevichi-Dolina was commissioned in 1977. The sheet says 1981, which no source found supports. Proposed as a change to 1977 with a spec concern. gem.wiki shows 1981 for string II, but it was read for leads only.

verifications.note: line listed as a current Belarus transit trunk in 2023

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Same evidence as string I. The 2023 Gazprom Transgaz Belarus page lists the two-thread line. Nothing dated 2024 or later was found for either section. Status stays operating with low certainty.

summary: "Real, not a duplicate of P3484; length 292 and start 1981 contradicted by operator table (366.7 km, 1977); capacity system figure"
